p.s: I do not agree the opinion of that young people nowadays do not give enough time to helping communities.
I argue that this opinion is not true for tree reasons.
First, I think that all youngers are living by suporting each other.
Though my experience, my friends always helped me when I got troubles.
Even I was supported by my fliends more than my friends.
I can say that if I did not have any friends, I could not get over the so many problems that I had in the past.
Of course when my friends are in trouble, I try to help them.
We have learned the importance of frieds and support each other freom thouse experiences.
Secound, in the public, I see so many young people who helps eldery people.
For example, people give up their seats and give them to old people on trains, buses or on any public ridings.
In addition, some people carry havy bags for eldery people in stores.
Tired, in my school, when someone breake his legs, arround his friends help him by carring his stuffs or leading him.
Or when someone is appcent, his friend takes notes for him.
I believe that all young people know the importance of helping other people and everybody helpes their communities.
